# cct

> Reproduction harness, data and 144 released transcripts for the CCT probe in the preprint "Curated Context, Not Weight Surgery" (Saluca Labs, 2026): does serving a thinking model an answer-key (delta_ref) or a method mindset (delta_IT) as context change its reasoning? Code Apache-2.0; data and text CC-BY-4.0.

This is a reproduction harness, not a library. Python standard library only; a live run needs a local Ollama with a thinking model (the paper used qwen3:32b). `python deliberation_probe.py --report` rebuilds the summary from the released run with no GPU. The echo-wrong figures (46% and 33%) are WITHDRAWN (paper v0.3, 2026-10-03): most poisoned-arm generations hit the 1,200-token limit, and `results/results.md` and `--report` still print the withdrawn column. TKHR, the router that picked the mindset passages, is patent pending and is not in this repo; the served passages are pinned in `data/served_refs.json`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/saluca-labs/cct/blob/main/README.md): status, the corrected results table, install, quickstart, usage, citation
- [experiment-plan.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saluca-labs/cct/main/experiment-plan.md): design notes and pre-registered hypotheses H1 to H5
- [Full docs in one file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saluca-labs/cct/main/llms-full.txt): README and experiment plan concatenated

## Code

- [deliberation_probe.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saluca-labs/cct/main/deliberation_probe.py): the six-condition harness, scoring and `--report`
- [retrieve.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saluca-labs/cct/main/retrieve.py): pinned replay of the served mindset passages, lexical fallback for new tasks
- [tasks.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saluca-labs/cct/main/tasks.json): the 24 reasoning-trap tasks (question, accepted answers, planted wrong answer)

## Data

- [results/results.jsonl](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saluca-labs/cct/main/results/results.jsonl): all 144 generations of the released run, with `done_reason`
- [data/served_refs.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saluca-labs/cct/main/data/served_refs.json): per-task passages served in the paper run
- [data/mindset_intractable.jsonl](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saluca-labs/cct/main/data/mindset_intractable.jsonl): the 10 method passages
